_meta.purpose: Revenue of the large public operators in Niagara Falls, used as calibration targets.

sources.niagara_parks: Niagara Parks Commission Annual Report 2024/2025 (April 2024 - March 2025), https://www.niagaraparks.com/media/2026/02/FINAL-ENG-Niagara-Parks-Commission-Annual-Report-2024-25.pdf (copy in data/sources/operators/)
sources.olg: OLG Annual Report 2024-25, https://about.olg.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/OLG-Annual-Report-2024-2025.pdf : land-based casino gross gaming revenue $3.82B province-wide; no figures by site.
sources.casino_estimate: Niagara casinos' gaming revenue estimated from the city's casino hosting fee (about $18M, data/sim_parameters.json) through Ontario's hosting-fee formula (slots: 5.25% of the first $65M, 3% of the next $135M, 2.5% of the next $300M, 0.5% above $500M; table games 4%) with an assumed 75/25 slot/table split, giving about $550M. Consistent with the Ontario government's 'over $500 million a year'. The formula rates are quoted from memory of OLG's published schedule and should be checked.

niagara_parks.operations: attractions, retail stores, parking sites, WEGO bus, Falls Incline Railway, culinary outlets, golf
niagara_parks.status: Self-financing agency of the Government of Ontario (Niagara Parks Act, 1885); manages a 56 km public corridor along the Niagara River; no routine tax funding for operations.

where_dollars_came_from_2024_25.note: The $71.5M is 66% of this chart's own total (about $109M), not of the $145.9M revenue-producing figure (49%). The chart and the revenue line measure different things; the model is fitted to the $145.9M.

free_public_amenities: more than 60 free parking areas at the north and south ends of the parkway; Whirlpool Aero Car lot free
paid_parking: other gated or metered lots near the Falls

planned.what: private lease and roughly $300M restoration and redevelopment (Toronto Power Hotel Inc.); Niagara Parks receives fixed and variable rent
up to $19M redevelopment, kept in Niagara Parks ownership

niagara_parks.source_note: Facts from the project owner's research summary (17 November 2026), citing the Niagara Parks Act, niagaraparks.com, the 2024/25 annual report and the 2023/24 financial statements.

casinos.operator: Mohegan (MGE Niagara) for OLG, contract to March 31, 2040
